# Code of Conduct

We want this project’s community to be respectful, collaborative, and safe.

## Our standards

- Be respectful and constructive.
- Assume good intent; seek clarity before escalating.
- No harassment, discrimination, or abusive language.

## Data handling

- Do not post secrets, credentials, tokens, or PII in issues, PRs, screenshots, or logs.
- Do not disclose environment-specific URLs/IDs unless explicitly safe and intended.

## Reporting problems

- For security vulnerabilities, do not open a public issue; follow the process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to participation in issues, pull requests, and any other project-managed spaces.
